"'''Shadow Three'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he participated in the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|attack]] on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] warship [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].
